rows.grounds: accusative plural of bheda (division/type), object of pravakṣyāmi
genitive of idam/etad (this), refers to the subject whose divisions are declared
future first person of pra-vac (to declare/proclaim)
compound kāma-nāma-varṇa-bheda with ablative ending -taḥ (from difference according to desire, name, and color)
